notes.title: 1.1 Update Released!
notes.content:
[h2]1.1 Change Notes:[/h2]

[h3][b]New Unlockable Items[/b][/h3]
-Bounce pads make for fun drop shafts
-Bigger bombs with bigger explosions!

[h3][b]Hardcore Mode[/b][/h3]
-Death carries a heavy price... can you make it to the bottom? 

[h3]Rendering improvements to make pixel art nice and crisp[/h3]
-The game has never looked this good!

[h3]Numerous small QoL changes and bug fixes[/h3]
-skip intro
-click on shops to open

New Asteroids will be required with this update.

notes.title: 1.02 Hot-Patch
notes.content:
Changes:

Laser Drill Mouse Controls
-aim and fire with your mouse , as well as the default controls

Sticky-Aim
-no need to hold buttons down to maintain your aim! 

Boulders color balance 
-Boulders are now darker to be easier to spot near the surface. 

Small animation tweaks
